resources.string: A read-only accessibility inspector. Turn it on, open any other app, then come back here and tap Refresh: it lists everything that app reports to accessibility on its last screen — every element, its text, state and the actions it advertises — so you can see what an automation tool would be able to read and control. It never taps or changes anything in another app.
Inspector is ON. Open an app, return here, tap Refresh.
Inspector is OFF. Tap below and enable A11y Inspector.

No report yet.

1. Turn the inspector on above.
2. Open the app you want to inspect and move around it.
3. Come back here and tap Refresh.
